instructions: Compare the base and current text for one changed root section. Does this change behavior? Answer yes when the change alters what the result does or covers: a capability, surface, non-goal, rule, interface, edge case, or criterion. Answer no when behavior stays the same: wording, typo, order, style, or meaning stated more precisely.
